name: Hissatsu Shikokiya Kagyou
source:
Some suspicious demeanors of their coworker. A series of cases caused by them and some secrets are left. They start investigating it using their bodies. As their investigation goes, a secret fact comes out. The girls start taking action to take revenge for the victims....

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
同事们表现出的可疑举止，由他们引发的一连串事件，以及仍未揭开的秘密。少女们利用自己的身体展开调查。随着调查深入，一项隐秘事实逐渐浮现。为了替受害者复仇，她们开始采取行动…

[摘自ErogeShop]
